description: The five approved public presentation groups. Detailed research categories and framework memberships remain unchanged.

categories.name: Sages & Philosophical Traditions
categories.description: Seers and philosophers whose teachings, texts, and traditions shaped enduring ideas about knowledge, discipline, and spiritual life.

categories.name: Spiritual Teachers & Social Reformers
categories.description: Teachers and reformers who connected spiritual, educational, and social work with service to communities.

categories.name: Scientists & Institution Builders
categories.description: Scientists, mathematicians, technologists, and organizational leaders whose work joined discovery with durable institutions.

categories.name: Rulers & Freedom Fighters
categories.description: Political leaders and anti-colonial figures studied through statecraft, public action, conflict, and historical memory.

categories.name: Cultural Figures & Nation Builders
categories.description: Artists, writers, patrons, and builders whose cultural or institutional work influenced public life across generations.
